issues: 画面左上角压着调试占位标题「CUBE ROTATE」
立方体悬在死平的灰底上，没有地面、没有投影，体块没有落脚点
面内 dashboard 用 transform scale(0.82) 缩放，3D 合成层里文字边缘发虚
共享棱画成 150px 纯黑渐变「暗棱」——凸角本应受光，读作脏阴影；明暗是线性对切
翻转是对称 inOut cubic 一转到底，没有预备与落定，整屏常驻 1.5px 模糊发闷
工作台时长被推断成 30f，翻转动作完全没演出来
changes: 去掉调试标题；补导出 CUBE_ROTATE_DURATION = 140（30f 建立 + 38f 翻转 + 72f 静止）
背景换成柔光渐变 Backdrop + 暗角，立方体下加两层地面软影（近地实、远地虚），宽度随投影宽度 ×1→1.36 变化
面内改用 CSS zoom 0.82 按目标尺寸排版，静止帧文字锐利；每面加 1px 发丝外缘立住轮廓
明暗改为按法线夹角 cos 压暗（正对 1 → 侧转 0.55）且远离镜头一侧再深一档，共享凸棱转动时亮起 1px 受光细棱
θ 曲线换成 bezier(0.6,−0.18,0.2,1.18)：先回拉 ~1.4° 预备、到位过冲 ~1.4° 回落；中段相机轻退 6%，按棱上线速度挂 ≤3.5px 横向运动模糊，静止为 0
issuesEn: A debug placeholder title "CUBE ROTATE" sat in the top-left corner
The cube floated on a flat gray field with no ground or shadow, so the volume had nothing to stand on
Dashboards were shrunk with transform scale(0.82), leaving text soft inside the 3D layer
The shared edge was a 150px black gradient 'dark seam' — a convex corner should catch light, so it read as a dirty shadow; shading was a linear swap
The turn was one symmetric inOut cubic with no anticipation or settle, and a constant 1.5px full-frame blur made it murky
The workbench inferred a 30f duration, so the rotation never played
changesEn: Removed the debug title; exported CUBE_ROTATE_DURATION = 140 (30f setup + 38f turn + 72f hold)
Background is now a soft-lit Backdrop with vignette; two layers of ground shadow (tight contact + wide ambient) sit under the cube, widening ×1→1.36 with the projected width
Faces lay out at CSS zoom 0.82 so text is crisp at rest; each face gets a 1px hairline rim to hold its silhouette
Shading follows the cosine of the face normal (front 1 → side 0.55) with an extra falloff on the far edge; the shared convex edge lights up as a 1px highlight during the turn

θ now uses bezier(0.6,−0.18,0.2,1.18): ~1.4° pull-back anticipation and ~1.4° overshoot settle; the camera eases back 6% mid-turn and a ≤3.5px velocity-driven horizontal blur applies only while moving
